_source: Transcribed from the recorded terminal output of the demonstration video (the summary table load-report.py printed during the 2026-10-17 run). Every number here is the run's own; it was not written to a file at the time. The 50 and 100 client stages are present because the run executed all three - only the 50 and 100 stages are cut from the video itself.
_transcription_note: Column values are read from the printed table. by_status is reconstructed from the exact identity requests = 200 + 502 + failures for each stage (1645+16+33=1694, 1959+17+7=1983, 1896+3940+61=5897). The key name for the non-502 failures is not recoverable from the printed table - only the count is - so they are recorded as 'timeout_or_error'.
